Name: Break Geodes In Bulk (No Longer Maintained)
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

[b]What does this mod do?[/b]
Break Geodes in Bulk at Blacksmith. Config Option to break all , or as much as there are empty inventory spaces(default).. Only breaks the maximum amount of geodes that the player can afford.

Now allows faster animation multiplier without needing other mods. This is because animation is hardcoded as opposed to using the original animation.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
Works on PC/Steam deck.
Works on mobile, but must set config option "UseMobileGeodeFix" to true to run different logic to prevent game crash when geode is broken.
